name: Laiterie de Saint-Malo
note: Saint-Malo dairy (SIREN 895780377, SAS, 9 rue du Clos du Noyer, Saint-Malo) that makes Yaourt Malo; Président de SAS is SILL ENTREPRISES (SIREN 636220220), with Henri León — of the founding León family — as Directeur Général. The Malo brand sits inside the same family-owned SILL federation. No state or fund stake found.
